# Mirta Syazanna

> Mirta Syazanna is a Malay-speaking property agent in Singapore and an Associate Director at PropNex Realty (CEA Reg. No. R070524E). She helps HDB owners plan and carry out upgrades to an executive condominium (EC) or private condo, in English or Bahasa Melayu. She works with her husband Andik Imran as Homes with AIMS (https://www.homeswithaims.com/).

Contact: WhatsApp or call +65 9710 8150. Free 30-minute upgrade consultation: https://mirta.me/#book

## Key pages
- [Home: HDB to condo upgrade planning](https://mirta.me/): 3-step condo upgrade framework (affordability and cashflow, property strategy, execution), client stories, FAQ on loans, ABSD, CPF and EC vs condo, and a Malay-language section.
- [Property Updates](https://mirta.me/property-updates): HDB resale prices for 11 towns in the North (Woodlands, Yishun, Sembawang), North-East (Punggol, Sengkang, Hougang, Serangoon, Ang Mo Kio) and East (Tampines, Pasir Ris, Bedok): median by flat type, change on the previous 12 months, highest sales and latest larger-flat sales. Refreshed weekly from HDB data on data.gov.sg. Also lists the evergreen upgrade guides.
- [Why EC buyers are quietly winning](https://mirta.me/post/why-executive-condo-EC-buyers-quietly-winning-singapore-property-market): EC income ceiling, first-timer status and grants, ABSD timeline for new ECs.
- [Upgrade from HDB to condo to landed with the 4Ps](https://mirta.me/post/how-to-upgrade-from-hdb-condo-landed): personal savings, property savings, promotion and profit.
- [Why more Malay families are upgrading from HDB to condo](https://mirta.me/post/why-malay-families-upgrade-hdb-to-condo)
